tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows positive short-horizon gain, while the archived dual-horizon mechanisms predict a possible slow reversal. Long-horizon observations are needed to identify that behavior before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit dual-horizon adaptation from the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All horizons are at most 0.48, so the slow timescale and long-horizon reversal are poorly identified for H = 19.9.
A fine short trajectory is less directly informative about the slow reversal than the horizon-discriminating probe.
The short-window observations alone do not distinguish these from endogenous adaptation at the target horizon.
